title.zh: 华尔街监管机构就投资顾问加密资产托管规则提出提案
title.en: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody

current_state.zh: SEC 于2026年10月1日提出的投资顾问加密资产托管规则仍处于提案阶段，新增细节显示该框架覆盖注册投资顾问和受监管基金，并允许特定条件下的自托管；评论期待定，所有条款在最终规则前不生效。
current_state.en: The SEC's Oct. 1, 2026 proposed investment adviser crypto custody rules remain at proposal stage; added details show the framework covers registered investment advisers and regulated funds, permits self-custody under conditions, and has a pending comment period; all provisions are conditional until a final rule.

updates.title_zh: 华尔街监管机构就投资顾问加密资产托管规则提出提案
updates.title_en: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody
updates.what_changed_zh: SEC提出新规则，规范投资顾问必须如何托管加密资产，此举将为向客户提供数字资产敞口的公司正式确立合规义务。
updates.what_changed_en: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
updates.current_state_zh: SEC提出新规则，规范投资顾问必须如何托管加密资产，此举将为向客户提供数字资产敞口的公司正式确立合规义务。
updates.current_state_en: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.

updates.title_zh: 美国监管机构推进9项加密行动，比特币11.3万美元行情得到强化
updates.title_en: Bitcoin’s $113,000 case strengthens as US regulators push 9 crypto actions
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了 SEC 10月1日提案的具体内容：为注册投资顾问和受监管基金设立加密资产托管框架，允许在特定条件下自托管，并承认州信托公司可作为托管人；评论期60天，条款须待最终规则生效。
updates.what_changed_en: New report details the SEC's Oct. 1 proposal: creates a crypto custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, allows self-custody under certain conditions, recognizes state trust companies as custodians, and sets a 60-day comment period; provisions remain conditional until a final rule.
updates.current_state_zh: SEC 于2026年10月1日提出的投资顾问加密资产托管规则仍处于提案阶段，新增细节显示该框架覆盖注册投资顾问和受监管基金，并允许特定条件下的自托管；评论期待定，所有条款在最终规则前不生效。
updates.current_state_en: The SEC's Oct. 1, 2026 proposed investment adviser crypto custody rules remain at proposal stage; added details show the framework covers registered investment advisers and regulated funds, permits self-custody under conditions, and has a pending comment period; all provisions are conditional until a final rule.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The SEC proposed a crypto custody framework allowing investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, the ninth US agency crypto action since Aug. 18, even as Congress leaves the SEC-CFTC jurisdictional boundary unresolved.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The SEC proposed a crypto custody framework allowing investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, the ninth US agency crypto action since Aug. 18, even as Congress leaves the SEC-CFTC jurisdictional boundary unresolved.
